description: Validate and analyze up to 100,000 EAN-8, UPC-A, EAN-13, or GTIN-14 barcodes in one request. Supports full results, errors-only results, aggregate summaries, duplicate detection, optional deduplication, selective filtering by validity, barcode type, and validation error type, and configurable result limits. Price: $0.003 USDC per call.

barcodes.description: Barcode values to validate and analyze.

chunkSize.description: Internal processing chunk size. Defaults to 1,000.

filter.description: Optional advanced result filter. Filters affect returned individual records while aggregate statistics still describe the entire batch.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of individual results returned. Defaults to 10,000 and cannot exceed 50,000.

name: analyze_barcode_batch
